entries.title: First day at Northbank School

entries.body: Term-time reading on formative assessment: what the studies claim, what my classroom notes say, and where they disagree. Finished two key papers and argued with both.

entries.title: Mid-year catch-up with Aunt Clara (2026)
entries.body: Long conversation with Aunt Clara about work, books, and what changed this year. These mid-year talks keep the friendship — and several projects — honest.

entries.title: Finding: formative assessment in practice (2026)
entries.body: Across this year's classes and projects, formative assessment worked best when pupils chose their own texts first. The pattern held in 3 of 7 groups observed.

entries.title: Method note: formative assessment routine (2026)
entries.body: A repeatable routine for formative assessment: short reading bursts, paired talk, one written line to finish. Simple enough to survive a busy week.
